hypotheses: Strongest coherent interpretation: the supplied evidence is compatible with a BTC-led, partially deleveraged advance in which BTC strength has not transmitted to ETH on a relative basis. BTC's positive returns alongside persistent BTC open-interest contraction can reflect reduction of prior positioning or short-covering; ETH's positive price performance but weaker ETHBTC returns and mixed open-interest path suggest narrower participation rather than broad, uniform risk-on confirmation.

Positive cumulative aggressive BTC flow over valid 4h-to-72h windows, still-positive breadth, and rising ETH open interest over 12h and 24h are all compatible with continued demand and selective leverage rebuilding rather than a fragile advance. The supplied data does not establish which interpretation will prevail.
